connector.name: O'Reilly Media MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search O'Reilly for tech books, courses, events, and more. Requires an O'Reilly subscription.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.oreilly.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the oreillymedia account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. OAuth is the recommended way to authenticate: OAuth-capable clients (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code) start the OAuth flow automatically when no token is provided. Alternatively, supply a personal access token here for token-based authentication.
